title: Johnny — Google Meet AI Meeting Bot
description:
Johnny is a single-user AI assistant that joins Google Meet meetings on the user's behalf and can listen, transcribe, suggest replies, ask for approval, or speak autonomously within configured constraints.

Runs as a daemon stack (Docker Compose) with a SvelteKit web UI for calendar browsing, per-meeting configuration, and real-time approval/transcript visibility.

Built around three swappable layers:
1. Meeting connector — Playwright+Chromium driving a real Google Meet session
2. Voice-agent pipeline — Pipecat with LiveKit transport adapter
3. Provider-agnostic STT/LLM/TTS adapters — cloud and local from day one

All meeting data (transcripts, router decisions, agent utterances) persisted to PostgreSQL with pgvector for transcript search.

## Goals
- Mark calendar events for Johnny to attend, with per-meeting context and behavior mode
- Four bot modes: listen-only, suggest-only, approval-required, limited auto-speak
- Provider adapters from day one (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Deepgram, ElevenLabs, faster-whisper, vLLM/Ollama, Piper)
- Local Docker Compose with PostgreSQL, Redis, FastAPI, SvelteKit, isolated meet-worker containers per active meeting
- Join as dedicated bot Google account or user's own account, configurable per meeting
- Persist full meeting audit log for post-meeting review
